review: shared native metadata integration before Aura publication
mode: read-only source review and bounded process-only probes; report is the only written artifact

findings.title: Keep big integers encoded as strings for physical writes
findings.description: encode() stores an integer outside Neo4j's signed 64-bit range as a string, but restore_types() calls _restore(..., 'big_integer') and converts it back before display_properties() supplies the write row. Thus a supported native metadata value cannot be published.
findings.probe: restore_types(encode({'example': 2**63}))['example'] is int; neo4j._codec.packstream.v1.Packer.pack raises OverflowError: Integer 9223372036854775808 out of range
findings.scope: Any authored scalar or nested integer outside signed 64-bit range; no claim that the current Aura source contains such a value.
findings.remedy: Limit physical restore_types to driver-compatible temporal restoration; reconstruct big integers only in decode().

findings.title: Do not silently erase declared component filter values when targets are absent
findings.description: The physical components property comes exclusively from resolved edges. An explicitly selected new surface such as docs does not collect Component records, so a Document with components=['finalize'] gets components=[] even though its authored /components remains ['finalize']. No unresolved-membership diagnostic is produced. The ordinary Aura component filter therefore misses the record.
findings.probe: enrich an empty snapshot with kinds={'Document'} and one NativeRecord whose metadata is {'components':['finalize']}; display_properties returns components=[], /components=['finalize'], zero edges, and only native_metadata_counts diagnostics.
findings.scope: New explicit native-surface selections omitting components, or authored component names absent from the loaded graph. The default all-surface Aura run includes Component records and is unaffected for resolved component names.
findings.remedy: Preserve literal declared component filter values independently of edge resolution and report unresolved component targets explicitly. Do not infer ownership.

findings.title: Allow native refresh to recover its inactive staging generation
findings.description: The refresh starts with migration inspect(), which rejects every generation whose status is not ready. publish() deliberately leaves a building or failed inactive Snapshot on an interrupted or failed stage, and otherwise supports resuming it. Retrying this command cannot reach that resume path because its initial inspection fails first.
findings.probe: A process-only fake database returning a failed Snapshot to inspect() raises ValueError('generation identity or readiness mismatch') before any node reads.
findings.scope: Retry after interrupted, failed, or CAS-refused native refresh staging. Existing current data remain safe, but a normal command retry is blocked.
findings.remedy: Inspect retained ready generations separately from strictly scoped inactive staging state, then validate/resume the intended stage, or provide an explicit guarded recovery path. Do not weaken ready-generation evidence validation.

other_reviewed_boundaries.reserved_property_collisions: No additional concrete regression found in the reviewed path.
other_reviewed_boundaries.retained_payloads: New generation publication does not rewrite retained entity or relation payloads; fingerprints check the retained payloads and endpoints.
other_reviewed_boundaries.identity_and_provenance: Existing entities retain canonical identity and SourceReference in apply_record; new native types use kind-scoped IDs and immutable source hashes.
other_reviewed_boundaries.query_digest_and_disclosure: Storage label adaptation remains outside catalog compilation; native metadata stays outside the disclosure SAFE_PROPERTIES allowlist.
other_reviewed_boundaries.decision_guard: Native Decision validation requires approved metadata plus matching canonical/native IDs and canonical source path.
other_reviewed_boundaries.sourcefile_test_dispatch: Dispatch was pending during review and is outside this review's conclusions.

limitations: No Aura writes or network database reads.
This report records findings before parent-agent repairs; it is not a post-repair approval.
